description: This file defines the MapController class within the Goteo application's controller namespace. It manages map-related actions such as rendering a map with optional geojson, channel, and matcher filters, and an exact map view with specified zoom and center parameters. It interacts with various models like MapOSM, BaseDocument, Node, and Matcher, and handles HTTP requests to produce map responses.

classes.name: MapController
classes.description: Controller handling map-related requests, including rendering general and specific map views with optional parameters.

methods.name: mapAction
methods.description: Handles requests to generate a map view, optionally including geojson, channel, and matcher filters based on request parameters.

methods.name: exactMapAction
methods.description: Provides a detailed map view with specific zoom and center coordinates, along with optional geojson, channel, and matcher filters.
